entities.name: Brago
entities.description: The immortal King Eternal of Paliano, once a living man and Selvala's friend, whose body was preserved by the Custodi until Selvala killed him.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: An elf explorer and Brago's friend who helped found Paliano and, at his request, kills him.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: A priestly order formed to preserve King Brago's body, who after his death announce that their king has risen.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The High City on the plane of Fiora, full of intrigues, founded by Brago and Selvala's Charter.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane on which the High City of Paliano stands.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane mentioned as being far from Fiora.

entities.name: The Charter
entities.description: The founding document of Paliano drafted by Brago and Selvala and ratified unanimously.

events.summary: At a private dinner, Selvala tells the withered King Brago that he is no longer the king she remembers and that she begged him to refuse the Custodi's treatments.
events.quote: I begged you not to let the Custodi begin their treatments.

events.summary: Flashback: young Count Brago sees the potential of the City and recognizes he cannot walk the path to it alone.
events.quote: And he could not walk it alone.

events.summary: Flashback: Brago and Selvala work inseparably, build a coalition, and together draft the Charter that forges Paliano.
Flashback: three years into his reign, Brago is diagnosed with an incurable hereditary illness, and he and Selvala reluctantly agree to the priests' magical preservation treatments.
events.quote: The Custodi were formed, and the king lived.

events.summary: Selvala accuses Brago of valuing his own life above those he served and says she would call any other man who spoke so a tyrant.
events.quote: if I heard those words from any other man's lips, I would know him to be a tyrant.

events.summary: Brago reveals there will be no more treatments because they have gone too far, and begs Selvala to kill him.
events.quote: I cannot die naturally. But I think I must die.

events.summary: Selvala forgives Brago and stabs him through the heart; his body crumbles to dust as he whispers that she will not, and she is escorted from the room.
events.quote: His ancient body began to crumble almost immediately

events.summary: The Custodi gather in the throne room to plan how to retain power after the king's death.
Brago's spirit appears in a blue mist and orders the Custodi to announce that the king has risen and that their work is complete; they hail him as King Eternal.

relations.note: Former close friends and co-founders of Paliano.
Selvala stabs Brago's preserved body at his request.
relations.quote: She thrust the blade once into the king's heart.

relations.note: The Custodi were formed to preserve the king and hail him as King Eternal.
relations.quote: The Custodi were formed, and the king lived.

relations.note: Brago is king of the High City.
relations.quote: The king, Brago, skin pale and cracked, like old parchment paper, rested in an ornate chair.
